faces.name: Powerful Broker
faces.oracleText: {T}: For each kind of counter on target permanent or player, give that permanent or player another counter of that kind. Activate only as a sorcery.

faces.name: Power Leak
faces.oracleText:
Enchant enchantment
At the beginning of the upkeep of enchanted enchantment's controller, that player may pay any amount of mana. This Aura deals 2 damage to that player. Prevent X of that damage, where X is the amount of mana that player paid this way.

faces.name: Powerleech
faces.oracleText: Whenever an artifact an opponent controls becomes tapped or an opponent activates an artifact's ability without {T} in its activation cost, you gain 1 life.

faces.name: Power Level Analyzer
faces.oracleText: As Power Level Analyzer enters the battlefield, you and target opponent each secretly choose a number between 1 and 10, then reveal. Power Level Analyzer enters with a number of +1/+1 counters equal to the distance between the two numbers. If both players chose the same number, put seven +1/+1 counters on Power Level Analyzer instead.

faces.name: Power Matrix
faces.oracleText: {T}: Target creature gets +1/+1 and gains flying, first strike, and trample until end of turn.

faces.name: Power of Fire
faces.oracleText:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature has "{T}: This creature deals 1 damage to any target."

faces.name: Power of Persuasion
faces.oracleText:
Choose target creature an opponent controls, then roll a d20.
1—9 | Return it to its owner's hand.
10—19 | Its owner puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library.
20 | Gain control of it until the end of your next turn.

faces.name: Power Pack
faces.oracleText:
Flying, vigilance, trample, haste
Whenever Power Pack deals combat damage to a player, exile target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard chosen at random. At the beginning of your next upkeep, you may cast that card without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.
